verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop docs claim it's a primary platform for IDEs, AI/ML tooling, and each release ships 'latest applications, libraries, and toolchains' plus full package archive access, which supports general dev-environment setup, but there's no evidence of preconfigured, one-click framework/language environment tooling (e.g., devcontainers, stack installers, version managers) specifically for quick setup. Missing for 10: dedicated preconfigured environment tooling, framework-specific quick-setup workflows, independent hands-on validation of ease/speed of environment setup.
